scope: Shared-ingestion-v2 coordinator with actual parser/canned transport; legacy formula helpers remain reference only

league.sql:
SELECT id, "sport", "seasonYear", settings
            FROM "League"
            WHERE id = %(leagueId)s

season_context.sql:
SELECT
                ss.id AS "sportSeasonId",
                ss."sportId",
                ss."seasonYear",
                ss."seasonStart",
                ss."seasonEnd",
                ss."scheduleBootstrapped",
                ss."scheduleBootstrappedAt",
                l.settings
            FROM "League" l
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
              ON ss."sportId" = l."sport"
             AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE l.id = %(leagueId)s
            LIMIT 1

subdivision.sql:
SELECT
                        id AS "sportSeasonSubdivisionId",
                        code AS "subdivisionCode",
                        name AS "subdivisionName",
                        "regularSeasonStart",
                        "regularSeasonEnd",
                        "postseasonStart",
                        "postseasonEnd"
                    FROM "SportSeasonSubdivision"
                    WHERE "sportSeasonId" = %(sportSeasonId)s
                    ORDER BY code

team_lookup.sql:
SELECT id
            FROM "SportTeam"
            WHERE "sportId" = %(sportId)s
              AND "externalId" = %(externalId)s
            LIMIT 1

phases.sql:
SELECT sp.*, td."sportConferenceId"
                FROM "SeasonPhase" sp
                LEFT JOIN "TournamentDefinition" td ON td.id=sp."tournamentId"
                WHERE sp."sportSeasonId"=%(season)s

fallback.sql:
SELECT sp.id
            FROM "SeasonPhase" sp
            WHERE sp."sportSeasonId" = %(sportSeasonId)s
            AND %(eventDate)s >= sp."startDate"
            AND %(eventDate)s <  sp."endDate"
            ORDER BY sp."priority" ASC, sp."startDate" DESC, sp.id DESC
            LIMIT 1;

upsert.sql:
INSERT INTO "GameResult" (
                sport,
                "sportSeasonId",
                "seasonPhaseId",
                "externalGameId",
                date,
                "timeTBD",
                "homeTeamId",
                "awayTeamId",
                "homeScore",
                "awayScore",
                "homeTeamExternalId",
                "awayTeamExternalId",
                "homeTeamName",
                "awayTeamName",
                "broadcast"
            )
            VALUES (
                %(sport)s,
                %(sportSeasonId)s,
                %(seasonPhaseId)s,
                %(externalGameId)s,
                %(date)s,
                %(timeTBD)s,
                %(homeTeamId)s,
                %(awayTeamId)s,
                %(homeScore)s,
                %(awayScore)s,
                %(homeTeamExternalId)s,
                %(awayTeamExternalId)s,
                %(homeTeamName)s,
                %(awayTeamName)s,
                %(broadcast)s
            )
            ON CONFLICT (sport, "sportSeasonId", "externalGameId")
            DO UPDATE SET
                "seasonPhaseId" = EXCLUDED."seasonPhaseId",
                date = EXCLUDED.date,
                "timeTBD" = EXCLUDED."timeTBD",
                "homeTeamId" = EXCLUDED."homeTeamId",
                "awayTeamId" = EXCLUDED."awayTeamId",
                "homeScore" = EXCLUDED."homeScore",
                "awayScore" = EXCLUDED."awayScore",
                "homeTeamExternalId" = EXCLUDED."homeTeamExternalId",
                "awayTeamExternalId" = EXCLUDED."awayTeamExternalId",
                "homeTeamName" = EXCLUDED."homeTeamName",
                "awayTeamName" = EXCLUDED."awayTeamName",
                "broadcast" = EXCLUDED."broadcast"
            RETURNING id;
